lines.1: It was pouring rain today, and everyone seemed a little less motivated.
lines.3: For some reason, Inori never showed up, so it became self-study.
lines.6: 「That's the tile, Fukahire. Ron. Ippatsu, plus a dealer haneman.」
lines.7: 「Damn it! You're as strong as the sexy-mahjong games at the arcade!」
lines.8: 「Those games throw out Thirteen Orphans on the second turn. Don't compare me to something that unfair.」
lines.11: 「That's not the point! This is still class time!」
lines.12: 「B... bourgeois! Your word starts with A.」
lines.14: 「N... an isosceles triangle. Finding the area is hard.」
lines.19: 「Yeah you did. You're not fooling us!」
lines.21: 「Why are you so obsessed with crabs anyway?」
lines.24: 「We haven't even gone twenty rounds yet...」
lines.27: 「I keep telling you! Even if it's self-study, we're still in class!」
lines.30: 「Is there really a crab called that?」
lines.31: 「There is. Legend says it is a transformation of people who died at sea during the Genko Rebellion of 1331. In other words, another name for the heike crab.」
lines.37: Everyone's movements and voices froze at once.
lines.40: 「Sato's voice carried the farthest of all.」
lines.41: 「Uu... I was trying to stop everyone.」
lines.44: 「Whoa, that's a camera. She planted a camera!」
lines.45: 「Hoho. This self-study period was actually my trap.」
lines.46: 「This class has a persistent tendency to wander off-topic.」
lines.47: 「I intend to examine the video thoroughly, determine exactly who causes the disturbances, and denounce them.」
lines.48: 「Heh, Inori. They look like chicks frozen under a snake's stare.」
lines.49: 「S-setting a trap for students when you're the teacher...」
lines.50: 「Honestly, that kind of idea is exactly why this class gets derailed.」
lines.51: 「Hoho. Now then, which one of you is the rotten orange?」
lines.52: Inori pressed play on the video.
